evidence_items.explanation: Frequent illegal endings and reported median lengths around 15 moves support recurring early failures in these configurations. The study does not supply a controlled phase-specific decline in move quality, and its game-count summaries contain inconsistencies.

evidence_items.explanation: For gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct, the report describes extended legal play, a median game length of 44 moves and 0.3% illegal outputs. This limits generalization across LLMs, but neither disproves often nor establishes stable move quality by phase.

unresolved_gaps: No adequate opening-versus-middlegame move-quality comparison was established for the relevant model population.
Aggregate game lengths do not identify the chess phase of each first illegal move.
Reported behavior differs substantially by model and configuration.
The May report has inconsistent subsidiary counts and includes two notation-ambiguity cases.
